Notes: ROUND AN. Every sound channel (Godot calls it a bus) the game has, one row each, top to bottom = the sliders in Settings > Sound. Master is the one everything ends up in. Bus = the name Audio.csv uses in its Bus column. Slider = the words beside the slider. Setting = where settings.json keeps it. Default = 0 to 1 on a fresh install. Add a row and a new bus and slider appear - no code.
Every row in Audio.csv with Bus = Music: the menu theme, the match songs.
Bus = Effects in Audio.csv: kicks, whistles, goals, duel hits, and every Juice.csv sound. Setting keeps the old name volume_sfx so older settings files still load.
Bus = UI in Audio.csv: the plank buttons' hover and click sounds.
Spoken lines. Nothing uses it yet; it is ready for when Audio.csv has a row with Bus = Voice.
